# E² Core Framework

> Public navigation index for the E² Core Framework. ORMD is the AI-facing authority; Semantic Substrate Markdown is the human reading surface.

Current AI entry point: https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/llms.txt
HTML AI mirror: https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/ai
Source repository: https://github.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework

## How to read this corpus

1. Start with the Context Layer Master Index.
2. Select the relevant A–I cluster and read only the ORMD documents needed for the task.
3. Preserve each document's frame, confidence, lineage, and policy metadata.
4. Do not treat the index, generated catalog, or human Markdown as a substitute for the paired ORMD authority.

- [Context Layer Master Index (ORMD)](https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/ormd/context-layer-master-index.ormd)

- [Machine-readable relationship graph](https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/graph.json)

## Cluster A — Foundational Axioms & Core Ontology

Scope: The irreducible bedrock of E². Establishes what relationships *are*, how they compose, and what constraints govern all relational systems. Every other cluster presupposes this one.

Entry point: Relational Primitives → E^2 Equation → Global Closure Operator

## Cluster B — Formal, Mathematical & Epistemic Constraints

## Cluster C — Dynamics, Emergence & Systems Frameworks

Scope: How relational systems change, stabilize, route flow, maintain continuity, resolve possibility, and generate emergent structure. Covers boundary dynamics, flow operators, resolution, persistence, the reconciled CFAR node (including AFD and CFA), AAF's scoped attention function, AVIA, emergence simulation, and tensional intelligence. The cross-primitive inquiry note sits in Relational Primitives in Cluster A.

Entry point: reconciled CFAR → Attentional Access and Formation → Resolution Synthesis; use the Relational Primitives note for cross-primitive emergence questions.

## Cluster G — Consciousness, Cognition & Identity

Scope: How the corpus investigates cognition, selfhood, identity, and unresolved questions about consciousness. Treats the self as a six-primitive coherence field with a provisional multidimensional profile, intelligence as field navigation, and cognition as collective substrate. Functional capacities do not settle subjective experience. Distinct from [F](#cluster-f "symmetric:constrains") (which addresses threats to cognitive integrity) and from [H](#cluster-h "dynamical:produces") (which applies these to social systems).

Entry point: Self as Coherence Field → Collective Cognitive Substrate → Relational Volition

- [Collective Cognitive Substrate](https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/ormd/collective-cognitive-substrate.ormd) — frame: cognitive.ecology.synthesis; confidence: 0.9

- [The 'Intelligence Field' Framework](https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/ormd/the-intelligence-field-framework.ormd) — frame: cognitive.theory.framework; confidence: 0.85

## Cluster I — Protocol, Infrastructure & Meta

Scope: The operational layer — how the Context Layer itself is structured, transmitted, and versioned. CLP defines the data model governing all other clusters; RPE is the simulation engine for relational primitives; Implementations is the living registry of E² applications.

Entry point: Context Layer Protocol (CLP) → Implementations → Relational Primitive Engine (RPE)
